name: pawl
description: Deterministic gates for coding agents: stops deleting home, root or drives (even from inside scripts), destructive git, unbounded waits, repeated tool calls, no-op edits, transcript re-reads, cross-conversation snooping and leaky or bot-sounding sends; strips zero-width characters; approves provably read-only shell commands. Plain Python, no model calls, no prompt cost.

readonly_auto_approve.title: Approve read-only shell commands
readonly_auto_approve.description: Skip the permission prompt for shell commands pawl can prove only read (ls, cat, git log, rg, ...). Off: you are asked as usual.

protected_roots.title: Repos the git guard protects
protected_roots.description: Colon-separated repo paths where pawl asks before git commands that discard work. Empty: the repo each command runs in.

strict_fence.title: Refuse reads of other sessions
strict_fence.description: Deny, instead of asking, when a tool call reads another conversation's transcript or files.

disable.title: Gates to turn off
disable.description: Comma-separated gate names: blast, git, poll, loop, noop, zero-width, fence, reread, readonly, send, idle (or egress, prose, budget).
